verdict.rationale: There is evidence of a stakeholder-facing view: holders click 'My Equity' to see their grants and exercise options, and they can review, sign, and approve stockholder consents via emailed links. That implies stakeholders get their own login, but it is framed around employee option holders, not investors. Nothing shows a structured investor-update feature or investors self-serving cap table and holdings information. Missing for 10: an investor-specific portfolio or holdings portal, a structured investor-update or reporting distribution feature, investor access to cap table data, and independent corroboration.
